notes: Credential checks scan private-key headers and common GitHub, OpenAI and AWS token patterns without printing candidate values; they are not a universal secret detector.
The three report Markdown trailing-space pairs are intentional CommonMark hard line breaks. Raw archives retain original bytes.
The editable report is marked -text so its recorded SHA-256 remains stable across Git checkout newline settings.
Coverage comparison normalizes historical absolute source paths so a different checkout location produces the same per-file names.
Git publication is verified after the delivery commit; this record avoids a self-referential commit hash.
